subject: ArrayExplorer doesn't work for an exon dataset

messages.author: 21b017a58b9d207c
messages.subject: ArrayExplorer doesn't work for an exon dataset
parts:
Hello.
I have Array Explorer working for several different summertime datasets of HuEx chips.  I have a new dataset, which I have loaded into Aroma today.  The process(ae) step works to completion, created the usual "reports" directory structure and the pngs and some html files.  But when I try to load them into Firefox, I get a big perpetually spinning grey wheel (quite stunning) and a title indicating that the sample is "Undefined".  This continues until I close Firefox.  I tried it on another set of HuEx chips and got the same result.  Could someone help me understand what is different about this dataset's Array Explorer output and why it doesn't load in Firefox?  Thank you.  If there are no off the top of the head ideas, I can send the necessary info.  Thank you.  kv

messages.author: 185f4d4fdb048fb8
messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] Re: ArrayExplorer doesn't work for an exon dataset
parts:
Hi Karen,

displaying probe intensities or probe affinities in ArrayExplorer
should not make a difference. Instead, I suspect this is related to
updates in the Javascript:s used by the ArrayExplorer HTML pages.

Try to remove the complete reports/includes/ directory and rerun
process(ae). That should recreate a new includes/ directory with more
up-to-date files.

Note, in order to avoid having to rerun already working ArrayExplorer
reports, make a backup of your working reports/ directory (it might be
that you'll have no problems, but I'm not 100% sure).

Let us know if this solved your problem.

Henrik
